shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- app files ---\\n' && rg --files app"
/bin/bash -c "cat app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- app/layout.tsx ---\\n' && cat app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort | head -160"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n 'proxy\\.ts|middleware\\.ts|proxy convention|Middleware' node_modules/next/dist -g '*.md' -g '*.d.ts' | head -100; rg -n 'proxy.*matcher|middleware.*matcher|middleware.*proxy' node_modules/next/dist/server -g '*.js' | head -50; cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log("'`${request.method} ${request.nextUrl.pathname}`)
+
+  return NextResponse.next()
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build'
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git diff -- proxy.ts'

/bin/bash -c "git diff -- package.json tsconfig.json; git ls-files --error-unmatch package-lock.json >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'package-lock tracked: %s\\n' \""'$?"; ls -ld .next next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -c "git status --short; printf '\\nGenerated build files:\\n'; rg --files --hidden .next | wc -l; rg --files --hidden .next | head -80"
/bin/bash -c 'git diff -- tsconfig.json; nl -ba proxy.ts; git status --short'
